item.title: University of Mississippi Medical Center clinics remain closed due to cyberattack

item.title: Supreme Court strikes down Trump’s tariffs, sparking fierce pushback and vow of new levies

item.title: Meridian police make first grooming arrest under new state law
item.description: An arrest linked to a newly-enacted grooming law in Mississippi has been announced. Law enforcement in Meridian took Dennis Palmer into custody on Wednesday.
